info.title: Whisp API
info.description:
Submit plot geometries as GeoJSON, WKT, or GeoIDs and get back forest, land-use, and deforestation-risk analysis from the [openforis-whisp](https://pypi.org/project/openforis-whisp/) Python library, backed by Google Earth Engine.

## Authentication
All `/submit/*` and `/status/*` endpoints require an `x-api-key` header. Register for free to get an API key at [/register](/register).

## Response format
Every response shares the same envelope:
```json
{"code": "analysis_completed", "message": "...", "data": [...]}
```
Error responses omit `data` and may include a `cause` field. See the [SystemCode](#/components/schemas/SystemCode) schema for all possible codes.

parameters.name: x-ee-project

schema.description: Optional Earth Engine project to run this analysis in. Without it the credentials' own Earth Engine access applies, which suits a service account key; an access token usually needs a project. Credentials are only held in the task queue, never saved with analysis inputs or job records.

parameters.name: x-ee-token

schema.description: Optional. Run this analysis with your own Earth Engine access token instead of Whisp's account. It must stay valid through the queue wait and the analysis.
